paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

The horizontal axis displays the method names, including "Full FT," "MTL-FT," "TAG," "LoRA," "QLoRA," and "Ours," arranged in a left-to-right sequence that is not strictly alphabetical or ordered by memory consumption. The vertical axis represents "GPU Memory (GB)" and is labeled with numerical tick marks at intervals of 20, ranging from 0 to 60, with a linear scale. Each bar corresponds to one method, with the height indicating the amount of GPU memory consumed. The bar for "Full FT" is the tallest, reaching approximately 70 GB, while "MTL-FT" is slightly shorter at around 40 GB. The bars for "TAG," "LoRA," and "QLoRA" are visually similar, each reaching approximately 20 GB. The bar for "Ours" is distinct in color (green) and reaches approximately 20 GB, which is the same height as the other methods except "Full FT" and "MTL-FT." No additional visual cues such as shading, borders, or annotations are applied to highlight specific bars beyond their inherent color differentiation for "Ours." The chart does not include error bars, trend lines, or other statistical indicators.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart, titled "QLoRA," illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) for various fine-tuning methods when applied to Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. The vertical axis, labeled "GPU Memory (GB)," is scaled linearly from 0 to 60 GB with major gridlines at 20, 40, and 60, and minor gridlines at 10 GB intervals. The horizontal axis lists seven distinct fine-tuning approaches: "Full FT," "MTL-FT," "TAG," "LoRA," "QLoRA," and "Ours." All bars except the last are colored orange, while the bar for "Ours" is colored green. The bar for "Full FT" is the tallest, reaching approximately 70 GB. The "MTL-FT" bar is next, at about 40 GB. The "TAG," "LoRA," and "QLoRA" bars are all approximately 20 GB in height. The "Ours" bar is the shortest among the non-orange bars, at approximately 20 GB. The bars are arranged in descending order of memory usage from left to right. The chart does not indicate any visual emphasis or annotation on specific bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm mit dem Titel „QLoRA“ visualisiert den GPU-Speicherverbrauch in Gigabyte (GB) für verschiedene Methoden zur Feinabstimmung von Sprachmodellen, wobei die x-Achse die Kategorien „Full FT“, „MTL-FT“, „TAG“, „LoRA“, „QLoRA“ und „Ours“ in horizontaler Reihenfolge darstellt und die y-Achse den Speicherbedarf in GB auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis über 60 GB mit regelmäßigen Tick-Markierungen anzeigt. Jeder Balken repräsentiert einen spezifischen Feinabstimmungsansatz: Der Balken für „Full FT“ ist der höchste und erreicht etwa 70 GB, gefolgt von „MTL-FT“ mit etwa 40 GB. Die Balken für „TAG“ und „LoRA“ sind gleich hoch und liegen bei etwa 22 GB. Der Balken für „QLoRA“ ist deutlich niedriger und beträgt etwa 12 GB. Der Balken für „Ours“ ist grün gefärbt und erreicht etwa 22 GB. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern in der Reihenfolge der Aufzählung in der Legende angeordnet, wobei „Ours“ am rechten Rand positioniert ist und visuell durch seine Farbe von den anderen orangefarbenen Balken abgehoben wird.
